messages.plaintextBody:
Charles,

Attached are the draft heads of terms reflecting our discussion: EV of £36m, £29.3m cash at completion, £1.5m escrow over 18 months and up to £2m earn-out on FY26 EBITDA. Exclusivity to 31 October. Let me know if the earn-out thresholds look right before we send to Castle & Vane.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 0012
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
